sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 4** across stylish San Francisco private eye investigations on *Candy Matson, YUkon 2-8209*, Herb Vigran starring in George Baker's post-war veteran sitcom *The Sad Sack* for Old Gold Cigarettes, Ginny Simms singing V-J Day homecoming swing for Philip Morris, Harry McNaughton bumbling as an amnesiac British butler on *It's Higgins, Sir*, Charles E. Fuller's biblical evangelism on *The Old Fashioned Revival Hour*, and waterfront arson investigations on *Police Headquarters*, Natalie Masters (1950), Herb Vigran (1946), Ginny Simms (1945), Harry McNaughton (1951), and Charles E. Fuller (1943–1951):
